title: Prior High Touch by Open Location
summary: How often the session reached the prior session's high, given where it opened inside the prior range: by default, opens in the upper half (open position at least 0.5, where 0 is the prior low and 1 the prior high). The denominator is sessions with a prior range that opened inside the chosen band; the numerator is the ones that traded at or above the prior high. Mind the geometry: a band nearer the level mechanically shortens the distance to it, so part of any rate difference is position, not behavior. Grouped by weekday by default; regroup or ungroup per run.

params.name: minOpenPos
params.doc: Only sessions that opened at least this far up the prior range (0 = prior low, 1 = prior high).

params.name: maxOpenPos
params.doc: Only sessions that opened at most this far up the prior range.

deltas: open location is a continuous band, not a fixed upper-half/lower-half toggle
minutes-to-touch distribution attached to every run
